prose: Bloomberg reports Goldman Sachs is restricting traders and bankers from using some AI tools. A major investment bank drawing lines around which models its dealmakers can touch is a reminder that enterprise AI adoption at regulated firms is being governed as much by compliance as by capability - the same week every other headline is about labs removing limits.
highlights: Goldman is restricting some AI tools for traders and bankers, per Bloomberg
Compliance boundaries, not capability, are shaping Wall Street AI rollouts
